categories.introduction: The Legume Ontology catalogs canonical culinary legumes, pulses, beans, peas, lentils, chickpeas, and legume-derived ingredients used worldwide in cooking. This domain models culinary ingredients, not botanical taxonomy, prepared meals, snack products, or beverages.
categories.name: Legumes
categories.seo_description: Explore canonical culinary legumes and pulses by group — usage intensity, identity, and pairing metadata in the PairingMethod Food Ontology.
categories.summary: Canonical culinary legumes across six immutable groups: Beans, Peas, Lentils, Chickpeas, Other Legumes, and Legume Products.

groups.introduction: Beans in the Legume Ontology — dried and fresh culinary beans used in stews, soups, and global pulse cookery, including kidney bean, black bean, pinto bean, navy bean, and cannellini bean.
groups.name: Beans
groups.seo_description: Canonical beans — kidney bean, black bean, pinto bean, and related culinary legume ingredients in the PairingMethod Legume Ontology.
groups.summary: Beans — 26 canonical legume ingredients in the Legume Ontology.

groups.introduction: Peas in the Legume Ontology — fresh and dried peas used in soups, sides, and global pulse cookery, including green pea and split pea.
groups.name: Peas
groups.seo_description: Canonical peas — green pea, split pea, and related culinary legume ingredients in the PairingMethod Legume Ontology.
groups.summary: Peas — 8 canonical legume ingredients in the Legume Ontology.

groups.introduction: Lentils in the Legume Ontology — dried lentils used in dal, soups, and global pulse cookery, including green lentil, red lentil, and brown lentil.
groups.name: Lentils
groups.seo_description: Canonical lentils — green lentil, red lentil, and related culinary legume ingredients in the PairingMethod Legume Ontology.
groups.summary: Lentils — 9 canonical legume ingredients in the Legume Ontology.

groups.introduction: Chickpeas in the Legume Ontology — chickpeas used in hummus, stews, and global pulse cookery.
groups.name: Chickpeas
groups.seo_description: Canonical chickpeas — garbanzo beans and related culinary legume ingredients in the PairingMethod Legume Ontology.
groups.summary: Chickpeas — 3 canonical legume ingredients in the Legume Ontology.

groups.introduction: Other legumes in the Legume Ontology — whole culinary legumes not governed by the Beans, Peas, Lentils, or Chickpeas groups, including soybean (provisional ownership), mung bean, adzuki bean, and lupin bean.
groups.name: Other Legumes
groups.seo_description: Canonical other legumes — soybean, mung bean, and related culinary legume ingredients in the PairingMethod Legume Ontology.
groups.summary: Other Legumes — 12 canonical legume ingredients in the Legume Ontology.

groups.introduction: Legume products in the Legume Ontology — processed legume forms with independent culinary identity per LEGUME-002, including chickpea flour, bean flours, tofu, tempeh, and miso.
groups.name: Legume Products
groups.seo_description: Canonical legume products — chickpea flour, tofu, tempeh, and related processed legume ingredients in the PairingMethod Legume Ontology.
groups.summary: Legume Products — 17 canonical legume ingredients in the Legume Ontology.

meta.description: Legume Ontology — canonical catalog populated (FOOD-11B). Intrinsic metadata only; relationships deferred to FOOD-11D/E.

aroma_profile.description: Reserved aroma characteristic tags — vocabulary frozen in FOOD-11A; do not populate until post-FOOD-11B curation standards.

canonical_culinary_groups.description: Immutable group names and slugs — do not rename or add peer groups in v1.

culinary_group.description: Canonical Culinary Group value on leaf entities — aligns to immutable group slugs.

flavor_profile.description: Reserved flavor characteristic tags — vocabulary frozen in FOOD-11A; do not populate until post-FOOD-11B curation standards.

texture_profile.description: Reserved texture characteristic tags — vocabulary frozen in FOOD-11A; do not populate until post-FOOD-11B curation standards.

usage_intensity.description: Intrinsic culinary prominence in dish composition — not Pairing Engine reasoning.

domain_exclusions.beverages: Legume beverages and plant milks — reserved; out of domain v1
domain_exclusions.herbs_spices: FOOD-07 — mustard seed and whole spice entities
domain_exclusions.note: Entities in these domains are cross-referenced by canonical ID only — never duplicated intrinsically.
domain_exclusions.nut_seed: FOOD-10 — peanut and sesame; not legume culinary identity
domain_exclusions.prepared_foods: Prepared meals, snack products, and composed dishes — not ingredient ontology
domain_exclusions.protein_foods: FOOD-01 / FOOD-14 — legacy legumes and soy groups superseded at publication
domain_exclusions.sprouts: Reserved — distinct culinary identity; not v1 unless governance amendment

legume.description: Canonical culinary legume, pulse, or legume-derived ingredient with frozen intrinsic metadata.

legume_category.description: Top-level legume domain hub (single category in v1).

legume_group.description: Canonical Culinary Group (Beans, Lentils, Legume Products, etc.).

botanical_ownership_rule.note: Suite rule — applies when botanical lineage diverges from culinary identity.

culinary_classification_rule.description: Cross-domain reference — peanut remains Nut & Seed per NUT-001; legumes do not reclassify peanut.

culinary_form_ownership_rule.description: Cross-domain fruit processed forms — referenced for suite discipline; does not govern Legume entities.

culinary_ownership_rule.description: Canonical ownership follows established culinary ingredient identity.

functional_pairing_rule.note: Suite wine-pairing rule — referenced for completeness; FOOD-11E may introduce domain pairing rule.

processed_product_rule.description: A processed legume becomes a separate canonical ingredient only when it possesses an independent culinary identity.

processed_product_rule_nut_seed.description: Suite processed-product baseline — LEGUME-002 extends for legume domain.

processing_ownership_rule.description: When processing creates a distinct canonical culinary ingredient versus a preparation state or alias.

schema.taxonomy_note: Groups represent culinary identity and culinary form, not botanical families. See docs/LEGUME_GOVERNANCE.md.
